hero-description:
I am chosen and adopted into God’s family. (Ephesians 1:4–5)

I am redeemed and forgiven through Christ’s blood. (Ephesians 1:7)

I am sealed with the Holy Spirit as a deposit guaranteeing my inheritance. (Ephesians 1:13–14)

I am seated with Christ in heavenly places, above all powers and authorities. (Ephesians 2:6)
